text_block_list.text:
Lunch break.
When I went looking for Mejiro McQueen
to discuss her training menu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
Things just aren't going well, are they...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Wait! Trainer?!
How long have you been standing there...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh!
So you saw that terrible dance too……!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I-It is not as if I am bad at dancing!
I am merely... unaccustomed to pop music."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, living up to expectations on stage as well—
that is the duty of a Mejiro horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry;
I shall master the dance in no time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... Look at that face. Thinking it's no use saying anything.
Honestly, you worry far too much."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then... um...
Please don't laugh if I mess up the dance.

I accompanied Mejiro McQueen in her special training,
and she mastered the dance splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... I was focusing too much on the choreography.
Maybe that's why I fell out of sync."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice.
I will start by analyzing the lyrics carefully!

After that, Mejiro McQueen deepened her understanding
of the song and mastered the dance splendidly.
